label: Preverbal tense-aspect-mood marking
statement: The APiCS survey describes Mauritian Creole tense, aspect and mood markers as preverbal; it discusses markers including ti (past), pe (progressive), fin/in/'n (perfect), a/va/ava (indefinite future) and pu (definite future), with interpretation depending on combinations and lexical aspect.
scope: Paraphrase of the APiCS survey's descriptive analysis; do not generalize beyond the documented Mauritian Creole variety or use as a substitute for the full source.

source_locations.location: Tense/aspect/mood discussion and Tables 5–6 in the survey chapter.

label: Position of standard negation
statement: APiCS records the standard negator in Mauritian Creole as occurring before the verb.
scope: Descriptive claim for the APiCS Mauritian Creole entry; no example sentences are reproduced.

source_locations.location: Datapoint heading and values section: Position of standard negation; value Before the verb.
